paragraphs: IntelliSafe Analytics builds a wearable device for workplace safety, described on its own page as patented, human-centered AI wearable tech that collects and analyzes physiological and behavioral data. The collected information is described as the engine for the company's artificial intelligence models.

Rather than a separate device or sensor for each hazard, the page says the human body reports every hazard it encounters and that IntelliSafe reads and interprets that information. Data capture is described at rates as high as 64 readings per second.

The problem framing on the page is unreported incidents, stating that most near-miss incidents never get reported and that safety information can be lost. Hazards named include slips and trips, overexertion and heat stress, with the page putting slips and trips at 23% of workplace injuries.

quote.text: IntelliSafe is working to protect the whole worker from all hazards.
